resources.string: Control playback of Nuvio for Android TV from your phone
Pair a phone to control playback and volume from it
On the TV open Settings → TV remote and frame the QR code. Phone and TV must be on the same network.
Replaces the paired TV: scan the code shown by the other TV.
This is not a Nuvio TV code. On the TV open Settings → TV remote.
The code expired or was already used: show a new code on the TV.
The TV did not answer. Check that phone and TV are on the same network and that Nuvio is open on the TV.
The TV refused the pairing. Show a new code and check that the date and time of both devices are correct.
Pairing failed. Try again with a new code.
The TV removed this phone: scan its code again
Play, pause, seek, subtitles, volume and more
Removes the pairing from this phone and, when it is reachable, from the TV.

The phone shows what Nuvio is playing on the TV and controls it: play and pause, seek by the interval set on the TV, skip intro and recap, next episode, subtitles and volume. Phone and TV talk only on your local network, encrypted with a key created when pairing. Nuvio must be open on the TV.
Nothing is playing on the TV
The volume is controlled by the TV itself (HDMI-CEC)
The TV can not do that right now
Connection lost: the controls come back when the TV answers
Creates and reads the QR code that pairs the phone with Nuvio on Android TV (TV remote). ZXing by the ZXing authors; scanner by JourneyApps (ZXing Android Embedded).

Controls of the Nuvio TV paired with this phone
Controls in notification and lock screen
While the TV plays, control it from the notification, the lock screen and the volume keys, even with Nuvio closed. They close by themselves after 10 minutes with nothing playing.
